class CharInfoWord(object):
    def __init__(self, word):
        b1, b2, b3, b4 = (word >> 24,
                          (word & 0xff0000) >> 16,
                          (word & 0xff00) >> 8,
                          word & 0xff)
        self.width_index = b1
        self.height_index = b2 >> 4
        self.depth_index = b2 & 0x0f
        self.italic_index = (b3 & 0b11111100) >> 2
